scene sky
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer because, despite how long we’ve known each other, I don’t think she’s ever come to my house yet.
Which is obviously something I both can and will change now that she is also some sort of sex-friend to me.
And, while I suppose it’s possible this could be misconstrued as me taking advantage of her...peculiar intellect and overall naiveté for my own personal gain, I have one thing to say about that.
So what?
It’s not like she doesn’t like having sex. And it’s not my civic duty to instill societal norms within her while she’s blissfully ignorant of all of them.

Plus, both Niki and Ami are out of the house until later tonight and I must seize this opportunity now, for I do not know when the next time I will get such a good chance to fuck her in the comfort of my own bedroom is.
: Friend! How do you feel about shrimp?
: Shrimp?
: Sorry — I meant to say micro-legfish. Did you know that they do not turn pink until they are delicious? Regular micro-legfish are actually a greyish-
: Yes, I know all about micro-legfish. What are you doing right now?
: Telephone!
: Okay. What were you doing before I called?
: Do you remember the store you came to just one time many years ago where I served you the large hot dairy circle?
: Vaguely, but only because it was really close to my house. That was all the way back in chapter one though and I didn’t think it would ever be relevant again.
: Well, it is! Because I am there — serving large hot dairy circles to people less prone to human trafficking. Why did you press my name button?
: Because I want you to come over here and hang out with me.
: For sexual purposes?
: That’s part of it, yes.
: Yay!
: Uhh...yay?
: My work becomes worked in three hundred seconds. After that, I will come to your housebox and spread my legs so you can-
: Yup. No need to go over it in detail while you’re still at work. I’ll just send you my address and-
: There is no need! Hello!
: Kaori? Are you still-
: Hah...
scene black
I’m just not even going to ask why she doesn’t need my address. I’m sure she has her reasons.
And I’m sure they wouldn’t make much sense to me either way.
scene kaorivisits1
: Friend! I have arrived. And I am ready to be penised now.
: We’re not supposed to do that in the doorway.
scene kaorivisits2
: Because others passing the by will become gelatinous upon watching my girl-hole be pierced by an attractive man’s cock muscle?
: Yup. So why don’t you just come inside first?
: I am confused. Do I do the penising this time? I thought you were the one who cums inside?
: Kaori, no. Come inside my house.
scene kaorivisits3
: The whole thing?! How virile do you think I am?!
Today is going to be a long day, isn't it?
scene kaorivisits4
I eventually manage to get Kaori inside of the house, where it only takes about five seconds for her to start freaking out about every single item she sees.
: Such a large box of temperature!
: Refrigerator.
scene kaorivisits5
: Refri...refur..re...ri...refrigeratoror?
: Why did you say it in English?
: Comedy.
scene kaorivisits6
: Why is this shadow so strange? What happened to it? Is your housebox magical, Friend? Is it the cum that gives it power?
: I think that’s just a rendering issue. They’re all over the place and I highly doubt it will change so long as we’re confined to whatever fate grants us our third dimension.
scene kaorivisits7

: Speaking of dimensions, did you know that the fourth dimension typically refers to time? And that the combination of this plus the three dimensions that make up reality or the “space” that we inhabit combine to form spacetime? Which is a much different thing than just what time it is in space. But also it can refer to a hypothetical dimension perpendicular to ours in which ideas like the “tesseract” would allow us to see all sides of a three-dimensional object at once.
scene kaorivisits8
: Where does this door go?
: That’s-
: I...actually don’t think I’ve ever noticed that before.
scene kaorivisits9
: Is this also a rendering issue? Like your special magic cum-plant?
: Hey, here’s an idea. Why don’t we check out the living room next? There are fewer shiny objects for you to get sidetracked by there.
: “Living room” implies the existence of a “dying room.” Please do not murderburger me. I have only just recently learned what it means to live at all.
scene kaorivisits10
: You were right about the shadows here, Friend. Your home is not so much a “house” as it is a “how?”
: This whole world is a “how?” My house is just the small section of said world that I set aside to masturbate and sleep.
: And the smaller, redder human lives here too? Or have you finished trafficking her?
: Ami still lives here, yeah. Though, I’m not exactly sure if she should at this point.
: Then I suppose she should be lucky you have not yet showed her the dying room. I wonder if that is where your mystery door leads?
: Kaori, can I ask you something?
: Is it about bees?
: No.
: Then I am a little upset, but you can ask me anyway since we are friends and I like how you feel inside of me.
: I was just wondering what you’d do if Nao started acting...different one day.
: Different how?
: Like scary and intimidating and powerful and just all around insane with no desire to change or even acknowledge the negative impact she is making on your life and overall existence.
: Is this about Thomas Two-Tongues?
scene kaorivisits11
: Hm...this is a difficult question to answer, Friend. For I can not imagine a Nao-chan who is not a perfect little daughterbug.
: Has your red child begun to scare you for some reason?
: Kind of. She just...doesn’t listen to me anymore. And every day, she’s getting more and more bold with how she decides to make my life Hell.
scene kaorivisits12
: But you love her too much to cut her into ribbons?
: That’s not how I’d word it, but yeah. I just don’t really know what to do. I want things to be like how they were in the past, but...
: But the future won’t become the past until much later.
: Yeah...
scene kaorivisits13
: Wait, what?
: Your pants keep buzzing, Friend. Are you sure you don’t want to ask me about bees?
: I don’t have any questions about bees, Kaori.
: Okaaaaay. But if you are keeping them in your pants, it is probably a bad idea.
: That’s my phone. And it’s probably just “the red child” again, so give me a second to talk to her and then I will gift you with the penising you so desire.
: Okay. I will wait here and think about which words I will use during the penising while you transmit your unease through a rectangular talk-box that is definitely not just bees.
: ...Right.
scene black
scene kaorivisits14
: Ami?

: Do I really come across as scary and intimidating and powerful and just all around insane with no desire to change or even acknowledge the negative impact I am making on your life and overall existence?
scene kaorivisits15
: Oh...good. So you’ve bugged the house too.
: The house, your phone, maybe even your glasses. Or maybe I’ve just implanted some sort of chip in your brain that transmits all your thoughts directly to me! Who knows at this point?
: So I just have no privacy at all anymore?
: I give you plenty of privacy. But this pertains directly to me and I don’t want you feeling that way anymore. So yes, I’ve decided to interrupt your date to try and nip this in the bud.
: By making yourself look even crazier? Solid strategy, I’ve gotta say.
: I’m glad you’re trying, Dad. It really does mean a lot.
: I know I can be a handful. Ten handfuls even. So many handfuls that it would take a brand new god to even hold me. But I don’t want to scare you. I love you.
: I know you’re still there. I can see you too.
: You’re playing with me....and I want you to stop.
: You’re playing with me too. We’re playing with each other. It’s like a game! How crazy is that?
: That’s just what we do, though. And I don’t hold it against you, so you shouldn’t hold it against me. Just be happy we’re playing together at all! I know I am.
: Are you really, though?
: No.
: But this just proves you know when I’m lying.
: Now, take that and apply it to everything else.
: Maybe then, you’ll get it.
: Anyway, love you! I have tables waiting. Chika’s absence is really fattening my wallet. I’m going to buy so many more spycams!
scene black
I hang up the phone and begin to come to terms with something I’ve probably always known — that even my home isn’t safe for me anymore.
This small part of this terrible world I’ve set aside for the things I mentioned earlier is now but one more prison I will lock myself inside because I don’t know where else to go.
Or maybe I just like being watched?
She gets that from her mother, I’m sure. And if Ami were to die next, I’m sure she’d haunt me too.
But she feels different than Sekai did.
Because for all her flaws, it never seemed like she wanted to hurt me.
And I’m just not sure if that’s true when it comes to this daughter of mine.
scene kaorivisits16
: Kaori?...
I’m not sure of anything anymore.
scene kaorivisits17
scene black
scene kaorivisits18
: Kaori...I didn’t give you permission to wander around my house unsupervised. You’re not supposed to be-
: What is this, Friend?...
: What’s what? This is Ami’s room. And, like I was saying, you’re not supposed to be in here.
: But why does it feel like this?...
: The colors. The smell. The air here is suffocating. But for some reason...
: I can’t bring myself to leave.
: It’s like I’ve been here before...
scene kaorivisits19
: My heart...it’s beating so quickly...but not for the reasons it was in the room of the living.
: It beats as if it’s trying to escape.
: I want to pull it out and show it that everything is fine.
: It hurts so much...
: I want to die.
scene kaorivisits20
: What, was the first time not enough for you?
scene kaorivisits21
: Right...
: I’m already dead...
: I...forgot for a moment...
: I’m not sure if I believe that. In fact, I imagine you’re the reason she barged in here at all.
: It feels so much different with a body...
: Being here...even when she isn’t home...it all feels so real...
: Because it is.
: The world kept going after you left. Which is why having you keep coming back like this is painful for me.
: You’re not supposed to be here, Sekai...
: No, Aki-kun....
: It’s painful because I am supposed to be here.
: Making breakfasts. Sending her off to school with a smile. Tucking her into bed at night. Cutting her hair. Teaching her everything you can’t because you’re not me.

: Take me...carve me open...and wrap the heart trapped in this hopeless vessel so tightly in my daughter’s sheets that I’ll be able to trick myself into thinking, even if only for a moment, that she sleeps within my arms again.
: Please don’t pass your suicidal tendencies onto other people. That body isn’t yours to sacrifice, no matter how badly you may want to.
: Sacrifice?...
: Is just wanting to rest really so sacrificial?...
: I never asked for this. I never asked for any of it. But here it is. Right in front of me. Teasing me. Taunting me.
: I’m not just a ghost this time. I’m me. I’m here.
: I’m really here...
: We should get out of here...I called Kaori here, not my dearly-departed ex-lover.
: Just a little while longer...please...
: Sekai-
: Please...
: I beg you...
: Let me stay...
scene black
I should have thought of this...
I don’t know why or...how I didn’t.
Just...all those moments where she was here felt more real to me since I could see her. Feel her.
But I never considered how she felt.
If she could even feel at all, the way she is.
And...
It’s the same thing I did with her daughter...
scene kaorivisits22
My selfishness has extended so far in the midst of my dolor that it has overtaken everything else and turned each fruit from my tree into fuel for my fleeting desires.
This is exactly how it felt so, so long ago. The only difference is I’m bigger now. And I would not be crushed under the weight of both her body and her misery as I can surely now contend with both.

But if I were to be held captive, in ways unlike the ways in which I am, I’m sure the despair would be malignant. That this pain would be nothing compared to how it would feel in shoes that don’t fit.
So I give her the time she needs. The time to wallow.
To stare at the floor and imagine the feet that grace it during late-night trips to the sink to fetch a glass of water.
Or those that scamper hurriedly across the wood each weekday morning starting at 5:00 AM on the dot so she can make sure I don’t leave this prison hungry.
If Sekai were still alive, Ami would be able to sleep in.
What a simple thought to end on.
: You know, Aki-kun...
: We can still be together if you choose this one...
: I could have my daughter back...
: You could have your light...
: We don’t need to be alone anymore...
: And what would Kaori have?
: What more could she want when she has already received the greatest gift of all in the form of life itself?
: I don’t need to always be here...
: Just...sometimes.
: Well...that would certainly make dealing with Ami easier.
: Like you said, I’m not you. I can’t fill your shoes and there’s not really much of a point in trying.
: Even so...
: I’m proud of what you’ve done.
: How far you’ve come from the little boy I knew so long ago.
: Do you...
: Do you hate me, Aki-kun?
scene kaorivisits23
: Do you no longer believe all I used to tell you?
: Has this place changed you the way it does everyone else?
: Change, huh?
: Honestly, I don’t think anything or anyone has changed me since you.
scene kaorivisits24
: Really?...
: Nothing I can pinpoint at least...
: There is...something, though.
: Something like...what?
: A dream, almost. Just one unlike those you’ve given me. One I can’t remember, but also can’t help chasing after.
: It just feels hopeless trying when I don’t know what to look for.
: Are you eating well? Sleeping well? Are you happy?
: You watch me all the time and you don’t know?
: That me isn’t always me, Aki-kun. You should know that by now.
: Even this one, who comes to you in borrowed flesh, is little more than an echo of a girl who never was. Who lost everything before she even lost herself.
: But in this moment, you know me to be real...right?
: I miss you...
: I miss my daughter...
scene himadate31
scene kaorivisits24
: I wish I got to experience just how much she could change me.
: Sekai-
: You still can though, Aki-kun. So don’t give up on her. Please.
: She’s like her mom. Broken. Scared. Just acting strong because she thinks the world will collapse if she doesn’t.
: And even if you’re not me, it doesn’t mean there’s nothing for you to teach her.
: Your love is the only love she will ever understand. Please don’t take it away...
: Sekai, if you’re still in there...why don’t you just talk to her?
scene kaorivisits25
: Like this?...
: Have I not already hurt her enough?...
: I...I don’t-
: Aki-kun...don’t give up. Please don’t give up. Please.
: We need to get out of here. The longer you stay inside of Kaori, the more worried I am she won’t come back.
: Aki-kun, please.
: No, we’re getting up.
scene kaorivisits26
: Akira!
scene black
: Come with me. Somewhere that isn’t going to hurt you.
: N-No! Don’t...pull me like...aah! I’m not...good at...using this body yet!
I drag her out of treachery and carry her off to somewhere between limbo and fraud.
